lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau banajaaro raam ko sahaj karau byaapaar ||
lines.translation: I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mai raam naam dhan laadiaa bikh laadee sa(n)saar ||2||
lines.translation: I have loaded the Wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: uravaar paar ke daaneeaa likh lehu aal pataal ||
lines.translation: O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense you please about me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mohi jam da(n)d na laagaee tajeele sarab ja(n)jaal ||3||
lines.translation: The club of the Messenger of Death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa taisaa ihu sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Love of this world is like the pale, temporary color of the safflower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mere ramaeee ra(n)g majeeth kaa kahu ravidaas chamaar ||4||1||
lines.translation: The color of my Lord's Love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant. So says Ravi Daas, the tanner. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee ravidaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Ravi Daas Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
lines.transliteration: koop bhario jaise daadiraa kachh des bides na boojh ||
lines.translation: The frog in the deep well knows nothing of its own country or other lands;

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aise meraa man bikhiaa bimohiaa kachh aaraa paar na soojh ||1||
lines.translation: just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing about this world or the next. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan ke naaikaa ik chhin daras dikhaai jee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord of all worlds: reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: malin bhaee mat maadhavaa teree gat lakhee na jaai ||
lines.translation: My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa bhram chookaee mai sumat dehu samajhaai ||2||
lines.translation: Take pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogeesar paavahi nahee tu gun kathan apaar ||
lines.translation: Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues; they are beyond words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prem bhagat kai kaaranai kahu ravidaas chamaar ||3||1||
lines.translation: I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the tanner. ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satajug sat tetaa jagee duaapar poojaachaar ||
lines.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, was Truth; in the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: teenau jug teenau diRe kal keval naam adhaar ||1||
lines.translation: In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is your only Support. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਇਬੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paar kaise paaibo re ||
lines.translation: How can I swim across?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਸਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mo sau kooo na kahai samajhaai ||
lines.translation: No one has explained to me,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te aavaa gavan bilaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: so that I might understand how I can escape reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bidh dharam niroopeeai karataa deesai sabh loi ||
lines.translation: So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practicing them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kavan karam te chhooteeai jih saadhe sabh sidh hoi ||2||
lines.translation: What actions will bring emancipation, and total perfection? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam akaram beechaareeai sa(n)kaa sun bed puraan ||
lines.translation: One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saa sad hiradai basai kaun hirai abhimaan ||3||
lines.translation: but doubt still persists. Skepticism continually dwells in the heart, so who can eradicate egotistical pride? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar udak pakhaareeai ghat bheetar bibidh bikaar ||
lines.translation: Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sorts of vices.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sudh kavan par hoibo such ku(n)char bidh biuhaar ||4||
lines.translation: So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant, covering himself with dust right after his bath! ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: rav pragaas rajanee jathaa gat jaanat sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: With the rising of the sun, the night is brought to its end; the whole world knows this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: paaras maano taabo chhue kanak hot nahee baar ||5||
lines.translation: It is believed that with the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, copper is immediately transformed into gold. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: param paras gur bheteeai poorab likhat lilaat ||
lines.translation: When one meets the Supreme Philosopher's Stone, the Guru, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: unaman man man hee mile chhutakat bajar kapaat ||6||
lines.translation: then the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat jugat mat sat karee bhram ba(n)dhan kaat bikaar ||
lines.translation: Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts, entanglements and vices are cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: soee bas ras man mile gun niragun ek bichaar ||7||
lines.translation: The mind is restrained, and one attains joy, contemplating the One Lord, who is both with and without qualities. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik jatan nigrah keee taaree na tarai bhram phaas ||
lines.translation: I have tried many methods, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turned away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prem bhagat nahee oopajai taa te ravidaas udaas ||8||1||
lines.translation: Love and devotion have not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad and depressed. ||8||1||
